name: Lakefield Campground
note: Township of Selwyn campground on 12-acre Hague Point at Lakefield, between the Otonabee River and the Lakefield Marsh: about 25 transient serviced sites (30A hydro and water) beside a larger seasonal section; beach, canoe/kayak launch and rentals, camper docks, comfort station, playground. 2026 rates: serviced C$55.11, unserviced C$46.08 a night + HST. Booked online (Let's Camp); 2-night minimum only on holiday weekends. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Township of Selwyn rate page live with nightly rates (C$55.11, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); township site map colours ~25 transient serviced sites; 2-night minimum only on holiday weekends; Google 4.1 over 151 with phone; C$55.11 ~ US$40
wf: township site map + satellite (Esri z17) at 44.43029,-78.27373: Hague Point between the Otonabee River (east) and the Lakefield Marsh wetland (west); the river-side rows along Beach Way are seasonal, and the transient serviced block (orange on the map, 171-227) lies on the marsh side behind a continuous wooded strip; the beach is a day-use area by the parking; default down; not waterfront

name: Nature's Inn Dryden RV Park
note: RV park on the sandy shore of Wabigoon Lake in the City of Dryden (Trans-Canada Hwy 17, midway between Winnipeg and Thunder Bay); RV Life lists it under an old name (Lifestylecamping). 25 sites with 30A, water (drawn from the lake - boil to drink) and sewer, plus small-unit and tent sites; city boat launch next door, trails into town, limited washrooms. 2026 daily rates: treeside C$45, lakeview C$46, lakeside C$48, pull-through C$54. Reservation requests by form, e-mail or phone (1 Mar-1 Oct), full prepayment, one night at a time welcome. Season 1 May-15 Oct. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$45, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); 25 full-hookup sites priced by the night, no seasonal tier on the rate page; Google 4.3 over 131 with phone; C$45 ~ US$32
wf: satellite (Esri z17/z18) at 49.7608,-92.8356: the RV loops sit at the north of the park; the southernmost pads look across an open lawn with scattered trees to the Wabigoon Lake shore ~50-70 m away, and the city boat basin on the east is beyond the park road (developed) - view, not frontage; lakeview

name: Happy Holiday Campground & Cottages
note: 15-acre wooded campground on Lake Duncan at North Temagami (Hwy 11): large drive-thru RV sites (30A or 15A with grey water), tent sites, two cottages and rental trailers; laundromat. Posted rates: 30A C$53, 15A C$45 a night + tax; seasonal, weekly or nightly stays. Booking by phone. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$53, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); drive-thru RV sites "for seasonal, weekly or nightly visits"; Google 4.2 over 106 with phone; C$53 ~ US$38
wf: satellite (Esri z18) at 47.1450,-79.7536: trailer rows on the strip between the Ontario Northland railway and Lake Duncan's west shore; the shore-side rows look across the park's open common lawn with docks to the water ~25-45 m away (a used common area, and the drive-thru traveller rows are not identifiable); default down; lakeview

name: Gibbs Camping & RV Resort
note: Good Sam Park on Shallow Lake beside Trans-Canada Hwy 11 at Mattice-Val Côté (between Hearst and Kapuskasing): 3-service RV lots and pull-throughs, tent lots, RV rentals, pool, chip stand, fishing; seasonal contracts too. 2027 daily RV-lot rates for 4 people: 3-service C$60 weekdays / C$70 Fri-Sun, pull-through C$80; long weekends may need 3 days. Summer reservations 15 May-15 Sep through the website or phone. Caveat (2026-10-08): the seasonal share was not measured. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with a 2027 daily rate table (C$60, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); seasonal share not measured (summer imagery only); Good Sam Park (isGsPark) with phone; C$60 ~ US$43
wf: satellite (Esri z18) at 49.6472,-83.2843: the park's front row sits between its lane and Shallow Lake ~25-35 m from the water across open grass with campers' docks; the rows behind look over it; the park mixes seasonal contracts and transient lots and the shore row cannot be confirmed as traveller sites, so default down; lakeview

name: Aintree Trailer Park
note: Family campground in Kincardine a short walk from the Lake Huron beach: 150 seasonal sites (1-5 year waitlist) and about 21 overnight sites - two-point back-in (30A, water, up to 40 ft), full-service back-in and drive-through, small-trailer/tent sites. 2026 rates including tax: two-point back-in C$71 (C$62.83 before HST), full service C$75 a night; one night to a few months. Booked online, one-day deposit per week. Season 7 May-Thanksgiving Monday. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$62.83, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); 150 seasonal + ~21 overnight sites in the CampLife engine (~12%); Google 4.5 over 162 with phone; C$62.83 ~ US$45
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 44.14717,-81.66554: dense rows inside a residential neighbourhood on the north side of Kincardine; the Lake Huron beach is ~300 m north-west beyond houses and streets (a walk to the beach, not frontage); not waterfront

name: Green Acres Manitoulin Family Campground
note: Family campground and restaurant on Sheguiandah Bay of Georgian Bay (Hwy 6, Manitoulin Island): 22 numbered beachfront overnight sites on the shared sand beach, a few in-park sites, tent areas and seasonal blocks; water + 30A, washrooms/showers, boat launch, fish-cleaning station. Overnight rates: in-park C$57.99, beachfront C$59.99 a night + HST. Booked online (Let's Camp) or by phone. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator site live with nightly rates (C$57.99, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); site map numbers 22 beachfront overnight sites beside the seasonal blocks; Google 4.0 over 279 with phone; C$57.99 ~ US$42
wf: operator site map + satellite (Esri z18) at 45.8909,-81.9192: the 22 numbered beachfront overnight sites line the east lane with their pads running straight onto the shared sand beach of Sheguiandah Bay (Georgian Bay), the water ~10-20 m beyond, no road or treeline between (cf. Meaford Memorial Park); bayfront

name: South Bay Park
note: Campground on Dunlop Lake 10 km north of Elliot Lake: about 124 sites, 17 of them nightly RV sites (15A or 30A with water, no sewer, some pull-through, rigs to 35 ft) beside seasonal sites, tent sites and 63 boat docks; canoe, paddleboat, kayak and fishing-boat rentals, canteen, recreation hall. A July 2027 weeknight sells online at C$58 (15A water) or C$60 (30A); unserviced C$53. Booked online (Campspot). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: operator booking engine quote (Campspot) (C$58, read 2026-10-08, no_rate follow-up); 17 nightly RV sites in the engine of ~124 (~14%); Google 4.5 over 60 with phone; C$58 ~ US$42
wf: satellite (Esri z17) at 46.47070,-82.66184: rows and a dock basin on a bay of Dunlop Lake north-west of South Bay Road; the engine's only shore type is 'Waterfront No Service' (rigs to 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft trailer) and the serviced nightly sites cannot be placed at the water; default down; not waterfront
